column1: # Persistence mapping counters (JPA persistence.xml and orm.xml, Hibernate *.hbm.xml): the counters
# of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included (so the HQL or SQL of a query in CDATA does not count),
# then one per mapping element, with or without a namespace prefix. "entity mappings" counts the
# JPA <entity> and the Hibernate <class> and subclass elements; "named queries" every named query
# of either vocabulary; "listed classes" the <class> entries of a persistence unit. The two kinds of
# <class> do not mix: one of persistence.xml has no attributes (<class>shop.Order</class>) and counts
# as a listed class only, one of an hbm.xml has them (<class name="shop.Order">) and counts as an
# entity mapping only. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
